priceSettings.title: Pricing
priceSettings.subtitle: Hourly rate, time units and coefficients applied to your estimates.

general.info: The hourly rate is applied to the calculation of the items

impact.info: The number of dents is converted into configurable time units (UT): 1 UT = 6 minutes

technicity.info: Difficulty index 1 is a PDR on sheet metal. Aluminium is increased here by a multiplier and PDR-on-panel work (DAP) is reduced. Diameter 2 is the reference diameter; diameter 1 lowers the reference price, whatever the pricing method.

variation.info: Difficulty index 1 is a dent on a roof. You can decide that a dent on another body part is X times harder to repair.
